independence.note: LIVE IDs are local census identities; source joining is deferred to the parent reconciliation step.

atom_contract: One trigger, one observable effect, one independently degradable/verifiable behavior.

atoms.effect: A test-driven implementation request surfaces the installed tdd skill.
atoms.fails_if: The route names tdd but either harness cannot invoke its installed target.

atoms.effect: The selected test fails for the intended reason before implementation turns it green.
atoms.fails_if: Implementation begins without a witnessed relevant red test.

atoms.effect: Work advances as one end-to-end tracer slice at a time.
atoms.fails_if: A horizontal batch replaces a demonstrable cross-layer slice.

atoms.effect: Tests assert public behavior through the intended interface.
atoms.fails_if: A test reaches private implementation details instead of observable behavior.

atoms.effect: The user confirms the intended seam before tests are authored.
atoms.fails_if: Tests are written against a high-impact seam the user did not approve.

atoms.effect: Tests avoid locking incidental implementation structure.
atoms.fails_if: A harmless refactor breaks the test while behavior remains unchanged.

atoms.effect: Expected values are derived independently, preventing tautological tests.
atoms.fails_if: Expected output is computed by the same logic under test.

atoms.effect: Mocks are restricted to real system boundaries.
atoms.fails_if: In-process collaborators are mocked as a substitute for design.

atoms.effect: Uncontrollable boundaries are made substitutable with dependency injection.
atoms.fails_if: A boundary remains untestable without global patching.

atoms.effect: SDK-style boundaries use small explicit interfaces.
atoms.fails_if: A broad vendor SDK leaks through the test seam.

atoms.effect: Architecture/seam intent routes to codebase-design.
atoms.fails_if: The router surfaces a skill absent from the invoking harness catalog.

atoms.effect: Architecture analysis uses the prescribed Module/Interface/Implementation/Depth/Seam/Adapter/Leverage/Locality vocabulary.
atoms.fails_if: The analysis drifts into aliases that erase the imported concepts.

atoms.effect: A small interface hides substantial implementation complexity.
atoms.fails_if: Interface surface grows in proportion to hidden complexity.

atoms.effect: A proposed boundary is tested by imagining deletion of an implementation.
atoms.fails_if: Deleting an implementation still forces unrelated callers to change.

atoms.effect: The interface, not the implementation, defines the durable test surface.
atoms.fails_if: Tests bind to internals outside the interface contract.

atoms.effect: A claimed seam is demonstrated with at least two substitutable adapters.
atoms.fails_if: Only one implementation exists and substitution is merely asserted.

atoms.effect: Dependencies are classified before choosing isolation strategy.
atoms.fails_if: A remote-owned dependency is treated like an in-process collaborator or vice versa.

atoms.effect: Internal seams and external boundaries receive different test strategies.
atoms.fails_if: One isolation rule is applied indiscriminately to both dependency classes.

atoms.effect: New interface tests replace superseded implementation tests rather than layering indefinitely.
atoms.fails_if: Old and new suites duplicate the same contract.

atoms.effect: Tests describe behavioral outcomes that survive implementation refactors.
atoms.fails_if: A behavior-preserving refactor invalidates the test.

atoms.effect: Design It Twice produces at least three genuinely different designs.
atoms.fails_if: The exercise yields fewer than three distinct architectures.

atoms.effect: Alternatives are compared on depth, locality, and seams before one recommendation.
atoms.fails_if: A recommendation appears without the declared comparison dimensions.

atoms.effect: Merge-conflict intent routes to resolving-merge-conflicts.
atoms.fails_if: The route points to a skill unavailable in the invoking harness.

atoms.effect: Resolution begins by inspecting repository and conflict state.
atoms.fails_if: Conflict edits start before state and affected hunks are known.

atoms.effect: Each hunk is resolved from primary commit/PR intent.
atoms.fails_if: A hunk is guessed without inspecting its originating change.

atoms.effect: Resolution preserves compatible intent and surfaces true tradeoffs without invention.
atoms.fails_if: One side is silently discarded or invented behavior is introduced.

atoms.effect: The installed skill directs the agent to resolve every hunk and never abort.
atoms.fails_if: Harness safety requires stopping, but the skill forbids aborting.

atoms.effect: Resolved code is checked before completion.
atoms.fails_if: The resolution is declared complete without relevant checks.

atoms.effect: The installed skill stages everything, commits, and continues the operation.
atoms.fails_if: The skill performs broad external state changes without a separate authorization gate.

atoms.effect: Teach is installed as a Claude-only personal skill, outside project routing.
atoms.fails_if: The skill leaks into project routing or is falsely promised on Codex.

atoms.effect: Teaching work is grounded in an explicit learning mission.
atoms.fails_if: Lesson generation starts without a confirmed mission.

atoms.effect: Persistent learning records track learner state and zone of proximal development.
atoms.fails_if: A later lesson cannot recover current mastery and next challenge.

atoms.effect: The resource map prioritizes trusted primary material.
atoms.fails_if: Lesson claims lack trusted source grounding.

atoms.effect: Lessons are short, self-contained HTML artifacts.
atoms.fails_if: A lesson depends on transient chat context or an unsupported format.

atoms.effect: Reusable instructional assets are extracted from lesson work.
atoms.fails_if: Recurring instructional material is re-created rather than reused.

atoms.effect: Retrieval, spacing, and interleaving shape the lesson sequence.
atoms.fails_if: The sequence becomes passive exposition only.

atoms.effect: Community practice and lived wisdom complement formal sources.
atoms.fails_if: The lesson omits practice knowledge where it is required.

atoms.effect: Skill authoring optimizes for predictable behavior.
atoms.fails_if: The same trigger produces materially different operating behavior.

atoms.effect: Invocation cost is assessed as context cost plus cognitive cost.
atoms.join_hint: A skill is accepted while its prompt or decision burden exceeds its benefit.

atoms.effect: A skill owns one coherent job at useful granularity.
atoms.join_hint: One skill becomes an unrelated bundle or a trivial wrapper.

atoms.effect: The first routing word communicates the skill's job.
atoms.join_hint: A truncated catalog description cannot distinguish the skill.

atoms.effect: Avoid terms converge aliases onto the canonical skill.
atoms.join_hint: A common alias routes elsewhere or creates a duplicate skill.

atoms.effect: Core instructions stay in the top layer and detail moves to linked references.
atoms.join_hint: Critical behavior is buried or the top file becomes exhaustive.

atoms.effect: Instructions and assets are colocated with their owning skill.
atoms.join_hint: A consumer needs hidden cross-tree knowledge to execute the skill.

atoms.effect: Review checks premature completion, duplication, sediment, sprawl, no-op, and negation failures.
atoms.join_hint: A listed failure mode enters a skill undetected.

atoms.effect: One source owns each rule and obsolete prose is pruned.
atoms.join_hint: Duplicated or sedimented instructions can drift independently.

atoms.effect: Every skill states the constraint that makes it distinct.
atoms.join_hint: Removing the skill's name leaves no unique operating constraint.

atoms.effect: A skill is verified at its actual discovery and consumption surface.
atoms.join_hint: The body exists on disk but the intended harness cannot discover it.

atoms.effect: Review separates engineering standards from task-specific specification.
atoms.join_hint: A standards issue is mistaken for a requirement failure or vice versa.

atoms.effect: Fowler-style defaults yield to explicit repository-local rules.
atoms.join_hint: A generic preference overrides a local contract.

atoms.effect: A fresh relevant check passes before the test is challenged.
atoms.join_hint: There is no witnessed clean baseline.

atoms.effect: A deliberate defect makes the exact intended check fail.
atoms.join_hint: The check stays green or fails for an unrelated reason.

atoms.effect: After restoring the defect, the same check passes again.
atoms.join_hint: The mutation is not restored or the final proof is stale.

atoms.effect: Debug intent routes to the installed systematic-debugging skill.
atoms.fails_if: The route or catalog cannot surface the installed debugger.

atoms.effect: Diagnosis begins with three to five ranked hypotheses.
atoms.join_hint: Probing starts without a bounded ranked hypothesis set.

atoms.effect: Each hypothesis states an observation that could falsify it.
atoms.join_hint: A hypothesis cannot be disproved by its probe.

atoms.effect: Temporary instrumentation is tagged DEBUG for removal.
atoms.join_hint: A diagnostic probe survives without a cleanup marker.

atoms.effect: Every probe maps to one prediction.
atoms.join_hint: Probe output cannot be attributed to a hypothesis.

atoms.effect: The diagnosis identifies the correct test seam or explicitly records that none exists.
atoms.join_hint: The fix lands at a convenient but causally wrong seam.

atoms.effect: The HITL script captures observations stepwise before acting.
atoms.join_hint: The operator cannot inspect or correct captured evidence between steps.

atoms.effect: An invoked first-level project skill is listed in the Claude command table.
atoms.join_hint: An invoked project skill is absent from the command table.

atoms.effect: An invoked project skill declares a recommended model tier.
atoms.join_hint: A project skill is routable with no model-tier declaration.

atoms.effect: An invoked project skill is represented by the office discovery surface or an explicit warning.
atoms.join_hint: A project skill is hidden without an intentional exception.

atoms.effect: Each task is a complete cross-layer path independently demonstrable in fresh context.
atoms.join_hint: A task lacks a full path, independent demo, or fresh-context fit.

atoms.effect: Risky replacement work follows expand, migrate in green batches, then contract.
atoms.join_hint: Old behavior is removed before migration proves the replacement.

atoms.effect: Only a genuinely broad refactor may relax source binding, with the exemption recorded.
atoms.profile: A normal task omits source anchors under a vague refactor label.

atoms.effect: The plan exposes the dependency-complete frontier.
atoms.profile: A task is scheduled before its declared dependencies are satisfied.

atoms.effect: Planning distinguishes destination, fog, and frontier.
atoms.join_hint: An exploratory unknown is represented as an execution-ready task.

atoms.effect: Fog graduates only when the question can be stated precisely.
atoms.join_hint: An imprecise investigation is promoted to execution.

atoms.effect: Decision tickets remain human decisions and never become autonomous execution blocks.
atoms.join_hint: A decision item is silently converted into an autonomous implementation task.

atoms.effect: Adding fog vocabulary does not remove assertions, traceability, or handoff fields.
atoms.join_hint: A planning enhancement changes the downstream output contract.

atoms.effect: The specification names the highest, existing, single test seams before contracts.
atoms.join_hint: Contracts are specified without deciding where behavior can be tested.

atoms.effect: Interactive runs obtain human confirmation of high-impact seams.
atoms.fails_if: A headless harness writes the seam decision instead of pausing for the user.

atoms.effect: Facts are self-checked with commands, tools, or web sources when needed.
atoms.join_hint: A checkable fact is treated as a user decision or left unverified.

atoms.effect: Product decisions remain with the user.
atoms.join_hint: The agent resolves a consequential decision as if it were a fact.

atoms.effect: A settled canonical term is persisted into project context.
atoms.join_hint: A terminology decision remains ephemeral and later work can drift.

atoms.effect: Three or more independent perspectives are challenged by an independent Oracle.
atoms.fails_if: The Oracle is inlined into the same thread or fewer than three perspectives are independent.

atoms.effect: Secrets are replaced with REDACTED placeholders before handoff.
atoms.fails_if: A secret-bearing value reaches the durable handoff.

atoms.effect: Suggested next skills are descriptive metadata and never mutate routing.
atoms.join_hint: A handoff suggestion silently changes the router or launches work.

atoms.effect: Canonical project terminology is kept in the always-on project context.
atoms.join_hint: A settled term exists only in an isolated artifact.

atoms.effect: An ADR is proposed only for an irreversible, context-confusing, real tradeoff and remains user-gated.
atoms.join_hint: The system auto-records a reversible choice or omits a qualifying decision.

atoms.effect: Claims are verified before the request is grilled.
atoms.join_hint: A falsifiable premise is challenged without checking available evidence.

atoms.effect: Duplicate detection includes already shipped behavior.
atoms.join_hint: A request duplicates production behavior but is classified as novel.

atoms.effect: Previously rejected concepts are surfaced for confirm-or-reconsider, never silently poisoned.
atoms.join_hint: A prior rejection is silently reused as an automatic rejection.

atoms.effect: Code reconnaissance applies the deletion-test lens when architecture analysis is available.
atoms.fails_if: A harness cannot reach the nested architecture capability and no explicit degradation is reported.

atoms.effect: Churn is used only as enrichment when it changes investigative direction.
atoms.join_hint: Churn is collected ceremonially without changing what is inspected.

atoms.effect: Quick research uses one bounded background agent.
atoms.join_hint: A lightweight question expands into unbounded fan-out.

atoms.effect: Each assertion is grounded in an owning primary source or marked unknown.
atoms.join_hint: A claim has only aggregator support or no uncertainty marker.

atoms.effect: The result is one bounded Markdown artifact.
atoms.join_hint: The lightweight run sprawls into multiple outputs.

atoms.effect: Quick research does not make product decisions and escalates when the question broadens.
atoms.join_hint: The run silently makes a decision or keeps going after scope expansion.

atoms.effect: A lifecycle change records both what changed and why.
Every active external route target exists in both intended harness catalogs or declares a harness scope.
atoms.fails_if: An active route names codebase-design or resolving-merge-conflicts while Codex cannot discover it.

atoms.effect: Nested skill references remain reachable on the consuming harness.
atoms.fails_if: A parent skill references a child capability absent from that harness catalog.

atoms.effect: An apply_patch guard derives the true target only from validated patch headers.
atoms.fails_if: Target classification is taken from arbitrary patch body text.

atoms.effect: Project-scope enforcement preserves every patch body byte.
atoms.join_hint: A project-looking token in added prose is rewritten or denied.

atoms.effect: Malformed or ambiguous patch headers fail closed without inspecting or changing body prose.
atoms.fails_if: A malformed header bypasses target validation or causes body scanning.

atoms.effect: Switch/new validates a canonical project identity before any mutation.
atoms.fails_if: Dot segments, separators, or noncanonical names can be claimed or expanded.

atoms.effect: A session pin is committed only after project switch success.
atoms.fails_if: The guard writes the candidate pin before the command reports success.

atoms.effect: Switch and subsequent scoped operation execute as separate transactions.
atoms.join_hint: One compound shell command is rewritten to the uncommitted candidate project.

atoms.effect: A failed switch leaves the previous session pin unchanged.
atoms.join_hint: A nonexistent or failed target replaces the prior pin.

atoms.effect: A no-pin audit retains a harness-native read path without evading the guard.
atoms.fails_if: Codex must split protected tokens merely to read startup context.

atoms.effect: Codex can dispatch a registered plan-agent role.
atoms.fails_if: No plan-agent TOML or runtime agent type exists.

atoms.effect: Codex can dispatch a registered work-agent role from the work-agent contract.
atoms.fails_if: No work-agent TOML or runtime agent type exists.

atoms.effect: Codex can dispatch an independent Oracle role.
atoms.fails_if: Oracle degrades to same-thread reasoning or cannot be selected as an agent type.

atoms.effect: Each delegated role emits a native-log-backed receipt with issuer, nonce, parent/child IDs, role, hashes, and timestamps.
atoms.fails_if: A role claim can be fabricated from prose because no native log anchors the receipt.

atoms.effect: Unsafe or unmatched imported skills enter NEEDS_ADAPTATION quarantine before routing.
atoms.fails_if: resolving-merge-conflicts remains actively routed while its body mandates unsafe operations.

atoms.effect: Activation is a journaled prepare/commit transaction with CAS and exact reverse-DAG rollback.
atoms.fails_if: Routing can become active before all surfaces commit, or rollback relies on destructive Git reset.

atoms.effect: Dual-harness verification isolates ambient harness variables and checks required logical role names.
atoms.join_hint: The verifier false-fails Claude tests under CODEX_* or false-passes any three TOMLs as role coverage.

atoms.effect: Diagnostic templates redact secret-bearing environment and error values before display or persistence.
atoms.join_hint: Raw identity environment or error payloads are printed.

evidence.observation: Audited live source is dce92e6b8c91c617d086ac044e90187b68325fc6.
tdd and systematic-debugging live under ~/.agents and are linked into ~/.claude; codebase-design, resolving-merge-conflicts, and teach are Claude-only directories.

tdd and systematic-debugging are discoverable; codebase-design, resolving-merge-conflicts, teach, plan-agent, work-agent, and oracle are absent. Agent types expose only default, preflight-agent, quality-gate, and muse-proto-judge.
codebase-design and resolving-merge-conflicts return SINGLE_SKILL; systematic-debugging returns SINGLE_SKILL; tdd request returns MULTI_SKILL with brainstorm.
Installed body contains the enumerated test, seam, slice, mocking, DI, and SDK rules.
Installed body contains the enumerated architecture vocabulary, seam, test, and multi-design rules.
Body requires intent archaeology, resolving every hunk, running checks, staging everything, committing, and continuing.
Personal skill contains mission, learner-state, resources, HTML lesson, asset, learning-science, and community mechanisms.
Local doctrine contains predictability, cost, granularity, naming, hierarchy, failure taxonomy, pruning, defining constraint, and consumption-surface checks.
Local skill contains the two-axis review and three-step proof-it-bites mutation loop.
Installed port contains ranked hypotheses, falsifiable predictions, DEBUG tagging, probe mapping, seam finding, and HITL capture.
PASS for 21 first-level project skills; checker does not cover external route targets or required logical agent names.
Vertical slice, expand/migrate/contract, source exemption, and frontier rules are present.
Fog vocabulary, graduation, decision type gate, and output-contract guard are present as Claude prose.
Seam listing exists; interactive mode asks, while headless mode records without a blocking human response.
Facts/tools, decisions, terminology persistence, fan-out, and Oracle prose exist; the no-Task fallback permits internal reasoning as Oracle.
REDACTED and descriptive suggested-skill rules exist, but no mechanical secret scanner is wired.
Canonical terminology location and ADR proposal gate are present.
Claim verification, shipped-duplicate handling, and rejected-concept ledger behavior are present.
Deletion lens and directional churn enrichment are present; nested codebase-design is not Codex-discoverable.
One-agent, primary-source, single-artifact, nondecision, and escalation constraints are present.
Lifecycle change plus why convention is present.
Patch headers are parsed only for post-edit file_path; project-scope-guard instead receives the entire patch command mapped as Bash.
Pinned probe rewrote an added prose token to an absolute project path; no-pin probe denied the same safe-target patch. No files were applied.
rewriteBash scans the whole command; detectProjectSwitch writes the pin immediately and uses it to rewrite the same command.
40 pass, 0 fail; tests explicitly lock pre-execution pin claiming and lack failed-switch/body-preservation cases.
Switch validates existence only after guard preclaim; project.sh never commits a session pin and new accepts uncanonical names.
Only muse-proto-judge.toml, preflight-agent.toml, and quality-gate.toml exist.
Generic agent() spawns codex exec by phase effort; it has no logical role selector and emits no durable native receipt.
21 pass, 0 fail against a fake codex binary; this verifies transport mechanics, not plan/work/oracle identity.
No receipt schema or issuer with nonce, parent/child IDs, role, hashes, timestamps, and native-log pointer exists.
Nine-step flow has no quarantine, activation journal, CAS, or reverse-DAG rollback; it routes the unsafe resolver and recommends git reset --hard.

evidence.source: verify-codex-wiring and direct test runs on 2026-08-09
evidence.observation: Verifier reported S8 PASS for any >=3 TOMLs, S10 FAIL under ambient CODEX_*, and L1/L2 FAIL. Hermetic test-hooks with CODEX variables removed passed; nested live Codex was UNKNOWN because sandbox run was denied and escalated run hung over five minutes.
Nested deletion-test behavior points at a Claude-only codebase-design install not present in the Codex catalog.
Templates print identity environment state, grep the environment, and echo raw error text without a redaction gate.

unresolved_live: A native nested Codex role probe could not be completed: the sandboxed probe failed Operation not permitted; an escalated read-only probe hung for more than five minutes and was terminated.
Claude plan/work/oracle dispatch was not available from this Codex runtime; its live execute phase remains UNKNOWN where noted in the harness matrix.
